description: Same output as /extract, but the page is first rendered in a real browser, so single-page apps and pages that build their content with JavaScript come back with their text instead of an empty shell. Waits for the network to settle (up to 15 seconds). Public pages only; no login. Use when /extract returns EXTRACTION_EMPTY or too little text for a page you can read in a browser. Costs $0.01 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

section.description: Optional exact HTML id to read only that element

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the page

name: extract_rendered
